training: stage 15 E1 protocol: all labelled units of the compartment, minus any sample duplicated in the test cohort

tests.notes: DIA1 and DIA18 are the same patient: keep DIA1 only; ING is a morphological mimic of DKD without diabetes
reference tissue is pilot nephrectomy: secondary contrast confounded by procurement; CKD-unclassified excluded

excluded.KPMP LMD: DKD < 5 and other CKD = 1 per compartment
excluded.GSE45980: filtered matrix, gene overlap too low
excluded.GSE163603: no other CKD; overlaps KPMP AKI

metrics: raw AUROC and shared-axis-adjusted AUROC (axis from training sources only); paired patient bootstrap vs B-L2 and B-cPCA; all comparators of FROZEN_DESIGN.json
reporting: every cohort and contrast reported regardless of outcome; each scored exactly once
